$comment: One adapter per source. Vendor feed URLs move and break; that is expected and is why each entry carries its own last_ok and consecutive_empty. verified_url means a person or an agent fetched this URL and got parseable RSS or Atom back with at least one item. It is not a claim that the URL works today; that is what health in latest.json is for.
$verification_status: 2026-07-27: microsoft-research fetched and confirmed (HTTP 200, application/rss+xml, 10 items parsed, 2 matching the keyword list). The other seven could not be reached from the environment this was run in, whose egress allowlist answered 403 on the CONNECT for every other host. A 403 from that proxy says nothing about whether the feed is alive, so those adapters keep verified_url false rather than being marked either way. Confirm them from an unrestricted network, or read the health block after the first real feeds workflow run, which has open egress.
